title: Effects of Market Size and Competition in Two-Sided Markets: Evidence from Online Dating
eligible_reason: Field experiment on an online dating platform that varies the market-size and competition-size factors (continuous F^ms, F^cs) shown to treated users; cross-sectional user-level logit/OLS regressions on these factors. No staggered binary treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: replication.R simulates 80,000 users in 200 markets and estimates Tables 1-5, e.g. feglm(search ~ ms_dev + cs_dev | gender + location, family='binomial', cluster='location') and OLS of log searches, like rates and matching on ms_dev and cs_dev.
data_files_note: No data files; replication.R simulates the user and swipe tables. Script comment: 'to preserve data confidentiality, the values used to generate the simulated data are not equal to that of the real data'.
data_provenance_note: Simulated user and swipe tables created in the script.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
